generatorConfig.pyproject_toml:
[project]
description = "Python SDK for the TraCSS REST APIs"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
classifiers = [
  "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
  "Intended Audience :: Developers",
  "License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License",
  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
  "Typing :: Typed"
]

[project.license]
text = "Apache-2.0"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/open-space-collective/tracss-sdk-python"
Repository = "https://github.com/open-space-collective/tracss-sdk-python"
Issues = "https://github.com/open-space-collective/tracss-sdk-python/issues"
